 Alonso’s possible reasons for leaving out Chelsea wonderkid from starting team once again 
 Wed, 28 Oct, 2026 Alonso’s possible reasons for leaving out Chelsea wonderkid from starting team once again 
 By Will Faulks 
 Add as preferred source on Google 
 Add as preferred source 
 Add as preferred source on Google 
 Chelsea have skipped over Estevao Willian once again when picking their team. He’s not going to be happy about this missed chance.  
 If you enjoy Talk Chelsea coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. 
 If there was one thing we were pretty confident about in tonight’s lineup, it was that Estevao would get a start.
 He’s been patiently waiting, and there are rumours he’s not happy with the game-time he’s getting. Tonight, a midweek cup game where two of our usual front three aren’t available, lined up perfectly for him to get a start.
 Instead he’s on the bench once again. Until now it’s been pretty easy to just say that the youngster isn’t at the level to be a starter for us.
 The fact that Geovany Quenda started ahead of him on Saturday was one red flag, tonight’s decision is a whole ship’s worth of them. we’r sure Xabi Alonso will be asked about it, but we don’t expect a good answer.
 Mystery deepens over Alonso decision to not pick Estevao again
 Xabi Alonso in his press conference Does he not trust Estevao’s work off the ball? Is the winger actually still being handled carefully after a long injury? There are a few potential answers, but none of them are very convincing.
 It’s all getting a bit worrying.
 In other news…
 Estevao’s absence isn’t the only notable thing about the team that Xabi Alonso selected for tonight’s game, you can see it here. 
 Joao Pedro is out tonight, and there are rumours of Chelsea interest in a new backup for him. 
 Jamie Gittens is having a disaster of a time at Chelsea, with injuries constantly preventing him from getting a run in the team.
